about: subagent_chat.py's script (owner, 2026-10-21: a sub-agent's chat is a normal chat). "Worker task: stream slowly" is the sub-agent's first turn, about 25 s of text, so the window can type into its chat while it runs; "Worker chat message one" is the message typed then, and "Worker chat message two" the follow-up typed after it is done.

steps.text: The worker reads each file in turn and notes what it finds, so the report at the end can say exactly what changed and why.
